description: Digiroad is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by National Land Survey of Finland. The Digiroad service closed at the end of September 2026. Road and street network data could be updated in the Digiroad service until 31 August 2026. The service was subsequently discontinued and is being replaced in stages by the new Digitraffic Road Network service, launching in 2027. Coverage: FI. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
